🛢️ Iran met Qatari mediators to end the Gulf war. Iran says Hormuz could reopen in 2 days if the US agrees. No deal yet.
🗳️ US midterms are Tuesday, after record early voting. What happens next with Iran may hang on the vote.
💻 The FBI says North Korea was behind the $6.3 billion Binance hack. Got crypto on an exchange? Turn on two-factor login.
🕊️ The local ceasefire in Ukraine's Kherson region is due to end Sunday evening.
🚌 Hundreds evacuated from Oleshky have reached Ukraine via Belarus.

1/5 Qatar talks to end Gulf war (2 days)
Iran met Qatari mediators in Doha to end the Gulf war. Iran says Hormuz could reopen in 2 days if the US agrees.
📷 Ank Kumar (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia

2/5 US midterms on Tuesday (3 Nov)
Americans vote Tuesday on which party controls Congress. Early voting has already set a record for a midterm.

3/5 FBI blames North Korea ($6.3B)
The FBI blamed North Korea for the $6.3 billion Binance hack. It's one of the largest crypto heists ever.
📷 Edwin.images (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia

4/5 Kherson truce due to end (6 days)
A local ceasefire in Ukraine's Kherson region ends Sunday evening. Melania Trump helped broker it so aid could reach Oleshky.
🎨 AI-generated image

5/5 Oleshky evacuees reach Ukraine
Hundreds evacuated from occupied Oleshky reached Ukraine via Belarus. About 2,000 still there could leave or get new supplies.
